Counsel for Petitioner :- Dinesh Kumar Shukla Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajan Roy,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
On 22.12.2023, following order was passed:-
"1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.
2. This petition has been filed with the following main prayer:-
"I. Issue a writ , order or direction in the nature of mandamus thereby commanding and directing to the opposite party No. 2 to 3 ensure fair proper investigation in FIR No. 1003 /2023 dated 24.11.2023 under section 376-D, 452, 323, 506 I.P.C police station Kotwali Nagar District Gonda as contained in Annexure No. 1 to this writ petition in the interest of justice.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: II. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing the responsible authorities arrest to the accused persons on the basis of first information report dated 24.11.2023 under section 376-D, 452, 323, 506 I.P.C police station Kotwali Nagar District Gonda as contained in Annexure No. 1 to this writ petition in the interest of justice.

entities.text: I.P.C police station Kotwali Nagar District Gonda
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
III. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing the opposite party No. 2 consider and decide the application dated 05.12.2023 and 08.12.2023 moved by petitioner contained as Annexure No. 2 & 3 to this writ petition in the interest of justice."
3. The State-respondent shall file a detailed para-wise counter affidavit to the writ petition.
4. List this matter on 17.01.2024 as fresh."
Today, none is present for the petitioner.

Learned A.G.A. has filed counter affidavit wherein it has been stated that investigation has been completed and charge sheet has been prepared, which is pending at the level of the Supervisory Authority.
In view of the above, the petitioner may approach the Supervisory Authority, if he has any grievance but nothing is required to be done, at this stage, by this Court.
The writ petition is disposed of, accordingly.
